I have fixed the `UserNotAuthenticatedException` error in [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r5/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt).

### Cause
In `TokenVault.kt`, the Android Keystore key requires biometric or device credential authentication (`setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` with a 30-second authorization window). Calling `vault.save(token)` directly without authenticating the user caused Keystore cipher initialization to fail with `UserNotAuthenticatedException`.

### Solution
- Integrated `androidx.biometric.BiometricPrompt` in [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r5/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt) before attempting to access the vault.
- Configured prompt authenticators for `BIOMETRIC_STRONG` or `DEVICE_CREDENTIAL`.
- Upon successful authentication, `vault.save(token)` and `vault.load()` execute while the user is authenticated, allowing Keystore operations to succeed without weakening the key's security requirements.
